<b>Shard Bundles</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{S|80}}. A maximum of 20 may be held at a time.


== How to Acquire ==
Shard Bundles can be purchased for {{R|50}} from various [[NPCs_(Silksong)#Merchants|merchants]] who carry an unlimited supply of them.

| rowspan=5 style="text-align:center" | {{R|50}}
| <i>To maintain one's tools is a constant task. These shards should be kept close when you travel, that you can repair and replenish as the need arises.</i>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Forge Daughter 01.png|center|200x200px]]
|-

| <i>Rkraha. Tnk uokn.</i>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Mottled Skarr.png|center|200x200px]]
|-
! [[Frey]]
| <i>Travellers should always keep spare shards close by. We Bellharters were once praised for our fine claw-work. An art lost on most modern pilgrims... excepting yourself I'm sure.</i>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Frey 01.png|center|200x200px]]
|-
! [[Twelfth Architect]]
| <i>Raw materials, for creation. Carry them with you always, that y-y-you may be prepared.</i>
| [[File:Mapshot SS Twelfth Architect 01.png|center|200x200px]]

| <i>These humble shards can form together into something grand, if you possess the vision to shape them.</i>

|}
